articles.summary: Most CPG digital transformation efforts are not failing because of technology; they’re failing because the foundation beneath the technology is rotting. When data is thin, knowledge is scattered and vital experience walks out the door, your transformation becomes an expensive illusion.
articles.title: The silent killer of CPG digital transformation: Data & knowledge decay

articles.summary: Consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies are facing the largest recipe rewrite in decades. From the FDA’s ban on brominated vegetable oil (BVO), which began enforcement in August 2025, to upcoming bans on additives, dyes and other substances in states such as California, Illinois and Virginia, the regulatory tsunami is only beginning.
articles.title: Escaping The Compliance Trap: Why 'Good Enough' Reformulation Will Sink CPG Leaders By 2028
